spans.s: झष (I) m. 1. A fish in general, Bg.x.31; 2. a large fish; 3. the sign Pisces of the Zodiac; 4. heat, warmth.
झष-अंक, -केतन, -केतु, -ध्वज m. a name of the god of love, स्त्रीमुद्रां झषकेतनस्य जननीम् Bhartr.i.65.
